lines.text: After managing to suppress Nihilister,
I stayed at Eden for a while and helped Cecil and Johan with their work.
*Zing*

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I heard the news.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're planning on leaving to track down Nihilister?
That's right.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That's a smart move.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Liberalio spirited her away just in the nick of time,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: but the nanomachines that were damaged by the Vapaus probably haven't recovered yet.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: At the very least, it's almost certain that Nihilister's ability to self-heal

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: has been significantly compromised, along with her offensive capabilities.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That means reasoning with her,

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: or even exterminating her for good, are viable options for the time being.
Don't get your hopes up.
I'll try both options.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I won't.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I understand accomplishing this task is something well outside the realm of possibility.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: No that's not quite right. Let's just say I'm hoping for a miracle.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: In general, I'm a very pragmatic person, but

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I haven't entirely given up on the joy that comes with having delusional fantasies.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: But don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: My expectations for this mission aren't exactly through the roof.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Oh right, I just remembered.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Johan intends to leave today in order to track down Nihilister as well.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: It might be a good idea for you two to team up.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: From what I saw last time, you both seem to get along.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: How about it?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You willing to work together one more time?

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Your hearts are in it,

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: but with a bit of time, I could turn you into a proper commander.
Johan seemed to feel the same way.
There's a lot I could learn from a combined operation as well.
I'm open to it.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Good thinking.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: I'll inform Johan.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Whoever finds Nihilister first will set off a signal flare.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: The Alva particle concentration in that area is extremely high, so communication will be spotty.
Got it.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You better get going. Don't want to waste any more time.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Bring me back some good news.
*Beep beep beep*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... A Heretic detector?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It seems like it's working, but should we really put all our trust in this thing?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It operates based on data gathered from previous engagements,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: so it can't be entirely useless.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: At the very least, we could use it as a divining rod.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't even start with that pseudo-science malarky.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm just saying...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I know the Commander was really miffed that Nihilister got away last time.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm glad there's a chance for us to have another crack at it.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I have a question.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: When we find Nihilister, what should we say?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well well, if it isn't the fire-breather?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Get ready to have your butt handed to you!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Pucker up, buttercup!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: This may sting a little.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Don't underestimate her.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: She may be weakened, but she's still a Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander, what's wrong?
I thought I just heard something strange.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: ... Huh?
*Beep beep beep beep*

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Could it have been the detector?
No, that's not it...
... *Drag*

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: That sound just now, was that what you heard?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It sounds almost mechanical, but it doesn't seem to be a Rapture.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: It's hard to determine since we're too far away.
Let's get closer.
Soon after.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I can't take one step without kicking around machine parts.
Could they be discarded weapons?
Are they junked parts for some kind of vehicle?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Should I pick it up and find out?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't think that's a good idea.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Some mysterious discarded machinery in the middle of nowhere?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: There is a high chance that they're Rapture fragments, or...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: All right, I get the picture. You don't have to continue.
*Buzz* *Drrr*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What is that sound? Talk about freaky.
Let's get closer.
I hold my breath as all of us head towards the sound.
*Crump* *Crunch* *Chomp*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Weird.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The sounds are getting louder,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but there are way fewer parts on the floor.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Wonder why that is?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Not sure.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whatever the reason, it's probably got something to do with what's making that sound.
*Crumble* *Crunch*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: There it is again!
... Wait.
There's something up ahead.
*Crump* *Crunch* *Chomp*
While the ominous sounds continue, something becomes faintly visible.
*Crumble* *Crunch*
Off in the distance, amongst the disarrayed jumble of machine parts,
Nihilister is attempting to restore her heavily damaged body.
Rapi and Anis begin to communicate via hand signals.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: (Should I use the signal flare?)

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: (No. We're too close to the target right now.)

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: (Let's create some space between us and her.)

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: (Roger.)
I follow the both of them behind a boulder nearby.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: (Should we keep backing up?)

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: (No.)

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: (Why not?)

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: (The sounds just stopped.)

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: (She might have noticed us.)

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: (I'll check it out.)
Anis pokes her head out above the boulder.
*Beep beep beep beep*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This stupid hunk of junk!
Anis frantically smacks the Heretic detector.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: ... Hmm?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: What was that?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Why does it feel like someone is watching me...
*Shoot*
Nihilister launches a searing fireball,
and the boulder we were hiding behind disintegrates.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: So, the irksome pests came all the way here to play?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: How did you know I was here?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: No matter.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Where are the rest of you?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Are they hiding somewhere like last time, lying in wait to ambush me?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Now that I've been weakened,

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: you fools think that you can actually take me down?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: If that's the case, then you are sorely mistaken.
*Crunch, crrrunchh.*

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: It doesn't matter how weak I am. I can still crush the three of you meatbags like the cockroaches you are.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sorry to disappoint you,
*Click*
Anis holds the loaded flare gun high above her head.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but it's not just the three of us here.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Even though I'm sure we'd be more than able to take you on.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Since we've got reinforcements on deck, it'd be a shame not to use 'em.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What I'm saying is that we've got backup, and we're not afraid to use it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: They're from Eden, and they're more than capable of taking you down a peg.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: ... Hmph.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I should have known you pests wouldn't have the guts to face me on your own.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Oh yes, I nearly forgot.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Before we get this whole bloody affair started, isn't there something we need to finish discussing?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You know, before the jellyfish interrupted us...

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I... I can kill for you.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I can still be of use to you!

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: The Queen... I... I'll kill her myself!
Are you saying you will assassinate the Queen?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: But if you're not interested and would rather duke it out, I'm more than willing to accommodate you.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I also highly doubt you'll be the ones coming out on top.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If you need us to save you, then you're gonna have to beg for it.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Why should I be the one to beg?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You wish to reclaim the surface,

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: yet you don't know the true nature of the Queen's existence, how she came to be, or even where she's located.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I, meanwhile, know all of these things, and even know how to kill her.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I'm clearly the one holding all the cards here.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I understand why you're tempted, but it's highly dangerous to negotiate with a Heretic.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If you give me the order, I'll fire the signal flare.
Fire the flare.
Let's hear her out first.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Affirmative. Now hurry and get out of here. There's no time.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: What the... have you lost your mind?!

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You over there, listen to me.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You're a commander, are you not? Don't you want to reclaim the surface?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You've got one of the Queen's confidantes offering you information straight from the horse's mouth.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Doesn't turning that down seem a tad simple-minded to you?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Fine, fine.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I'll tell you everything you need to know within that time.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You can decide whether you want to make a deal or not after.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You're not going to get a more generous offer than that from me.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You're not scared, are you?
Fine. You've got 10 minutes.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: A wise decision, human.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I've got a few surprises that I'd like to share with you all.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: For this short period of time, let's set aside our differences and have a nice heart-to-heart.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Wow.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I actually got through to that pea-sized brain of yours, human?

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: You may not be half-bad after all.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: Don't think I'm doing this out of any kind of fondness towards you, but...

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I'll fill you all in on a few things you don't know about.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I've been meaning to share a few things with you for a while now.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: All right then.
*Slouch*
Nihilister sits atop a pile of discarded machine parts.

lines.speaker: nihilister
lines.text: I'm only going to say this once, so listen carefully.
